messages:
Maya (Support): forwarding a customer ticket — ACME reports their webhook/func-invoke to /v1/tools/process_order is failing with 422 schema validation. They pasted the error: `ValidationError: line_items[0].unit_price: expected integer but got string '19.99'`. Customer says it only fails for some orders.

Maya (Support): customer payload (redacted):
```
{
  "order_id": "ORD-8891",
  "line_items": [
    { "sku": "T-100", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": "19.99" }
  ],
  "metadata": { "source": "checkout-js" }
}
```

Liam (Eng): thanks — can you ask for the exact API error body and a curl repro? 422 implies our JSON Schema flagged type mismatch. Curious why unit_price is a string.

Maya (Support): pasted the exact error from logs (customer copy):
```
{"error":"SchemaValidationError","message":"/line_items/0/unit_price: expected integer","details":{"path":"/line_items/0/unit_price","expected":"integer","received":"string","value":"19.99"}}
```

Liam (Eng): trying a local repro now. If they're sending dollars as a decimal string we expect cents as integer in our function schema (legacy). Repro steps for eng:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/process_order \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-8891","line_items":[{"sku":"T-100","quantity":2,"unit_price":"19.99"}]}'
```

Priya (QA): I ran the curl against staging and see the same 422. Full stack trace (staging logs):
```
ValidationError: node '/line_items/0/unit_price' fails schema 'integer'
    at validate (/app/node_modules/ajv/lib/ajv.js:...)
    at runValidation (/srv/runtime/validator.js:42:15)
    at handleInvocation (/srv/runtime/handler.js:110:7)
```
Also seeing variations where SDK v0.8.2 sends unit_price as number 19.99 (float) and our schema also rejects floats since it expects integer cents. So two failure modes: string decimal and float.

Liam (Eng): right — schema historically required integer cents. Two remediation options: 1) update schema to accept integer OR numeric strings OR floats (with server-side coercion), or 2) keep strict schema and document/validate client-side before calling. For immediate customer unblock, we can accept strings that look like decimals and coerce.

Priya (QA): quick patch test on staging: I added a thin pre-validate step that converts string/float to integer cents: `Math.round(parseFloat(v) * 100)` for unit_price. With that change the same payload succeeds. Repro (staging): 200 OK + {"status":"accepted","order_id":"ORD-8891"}.

Liam (Eng): good. I opened an internal PR to add a tolerant input adapter for process_order that:
- accepts integer (cents)
- accepts numeric (float) and converts to cents
- accepts decimal string and converts to cents only if it matches `^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$` else rejects
Patch also logs original type for telemetry.

PRI (action): will run compatibility tests across SDK versions.

Maya (Support): customer update: they said the checkout lib was upgraded last week and might be sending decimals as strings. They're OK with a temporary workaround: multiply by 100 client-side.

Liam (Eng): plan: patch in staging for 24h smoke, then deploy to prod with feature flag. If telemetry shows >0.5% of calls with string/float unit_price we’ll keep tolerant mode on and follow up with API deprecation notice.

deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for patch/process_order-input-adapter to staging (build 3182).

Maya (Support): sending customer the suggested immediate workaround (coerce to integer cents) + ETA for patch. Will escalate if they hit further failures. :thumbsup:
